description: This file defines the Express router for user-related API endpoints, including listing users, retrieving current user info, creating new users, and deleting users. It includes middleware for authentication and role-based access control.

methods.name: get /
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /api/users, returning a list of users (restricted to SuperAdmin).

methods.name: get /me
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /api/users/me, returning the current authenticated user's info.

methods.name: post /
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /api/users, creating a new user (restricted to SuperAdmin).

methods.name: delete /:id
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to /api/users/:id, deleting the specified user (restricted to SuperAdmin).
